title: Topological isomers in lanthanide–chloranilate coordination polymers: synthesis, structure and CO2 adsorption properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27809-27817
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02049F, Paper
Open Access

Kenika Khotchasanthong, Chombongkot Sricharoen, Pacharapon Jearanaiwiwat, Kunlanit Chinchan, Sakchai Laksee, Bunyarat Rungtaweevoranit, Mongkol Sukwattanasinitt, Kittipong Chainok
This study shows how lanthanide contraction affects topological isomerism, honeycomb and brick-wall, in 2D lanthanide–chloranilate networks, highlighting the importance of topology in volumetric CO2 adsorption capacity.
